title: A WordPress menu the copy alone holds is not taken as the live one: its new item waits for the menu or is held
steps: Run the changeset case: the copy keeps a nav_menu term deleted on live, with a new menu item in it and one in a live menu.
expect: The item in the deleted menu depends on the push creating that menu; held as a conflict when the sync kept the deletion.
The item in the live menu has no dependency.

tests: WordPress: a menu the customer deleted on live that the copy kept is no menu of the live site
